source_text: Dextera tua, Domine, glorificata est in virtute; dextera tua confregit inimicos. Dextera — Christus, brachium Domini. In cruce hostes confringuntur.
pass_a_gloss: Right-hand your, Lord, glorified is in power; right-hand your shattered enemies. Right-hand — Christ, arm of-Lord. On cross enemies are-shattered.
pass_b_english: [[Your right hand, O Lord, is glorified in power; your right hand has shattered the enemy >> Bible:Exodus 15:6]]. The right hand is Christ, the [[arm of the Lord >> Bible:Isaiah 53:1]]. At the cross the hostile powers are broken.
